description:
When IO is non-seekable (e.g., HTTP response body), the XXE check reads 8KB for inspection but cannot rewind.

Problem: The already-consumed 8KB is passed to XML::Reader, which will miss content in the first 8KB. DOCTYPE/entity could be in that range, bypassing XXE protection.

Fix: For non-seekable streams, buffer the first 8KB + remaining content (with size limits), or reject non-seekable IO entirely with an error.

comments.text: Reopening context: this was closed on 2026-05-30 but the underlying bug is still present in src/fetcher/xml_streaming_parser.cr#check_xxe_risk — non-seekable IO still triggers 'remaining = io.read' with no size cap. The actual fix is tracked at fetcherc-zr5.1.

title: XMLStreamingParser XXE check consumes stream but doesn't rewind on non-seekable IO
